scope: global endpoint status for all 3 sessions; one in-flight frame; no per-session status register
source: BT_SOFT_RESET_AND_STATUS_DESIGN_20261016 + PC2 v3 multi-session draft + B 2026-10-30 reply

address_binding.reason: Do not guess BAR offsets; B must confirm free offsets and cross-domain behavior against the new RTL
address_binding.control_node: existing validated ANLOGIC control/user character device

b_alias_report.detail: B reports internal AXI-Lite 0x000800A8 write=1 triggers both CONTROL and vendor RAM[42]; 0x000810A8 write 0xDEADBEEF modifies the same RAM cell; top-level only decodes [15:8]==0 and low 8 bits and ignores [31:16].
b_alias_report.pc2_action: do not access candidate CONTROL/STATUS/0xB0..0xBC until B binds and masks the alias

pc2_board_observation.soft_reset: CONTROL bit0 after bad CRC changed STATUS to 0x00FF002E (FAULT=1 ERR=7) and did not recover
pc2_board_observation.caveat: PC2 used candidate offsets after B burned M and user authorized testing; possible vendor RAM alias side effect; no further candidate access

status_register.access: read-only 32-bit pread; atomic snapshot; no read-clear; host may read twice and require equal values

bits.name: DONE
bits.meaning: ATTENTION/TEST C2H payload is stable and readable; stays set until ACK_DONE

bits.name: ERR
bits.meaning: coarse legacy error; valid with DONE=1 or FAULT=1

bits.name: READY
bits.meaning: can accept a new H2C frame; 1 only when BUSY=0, DONE=0, FAULT=0, RESET_BUSY=0

bits.name: FAULT
bits.meaning: sticky fail-stop; no new H2C; cleared only by SOFT_RESET

bits.name: BUSY
bits.meaning: a frame has been accepted and is being processed; host must not write H2C

bits.name: RESET_BUSY
bits.meaning: global SOFT_RESET or in-band RESET_CACHE is in progress; READY=0

bits.name: FAULT_CODE
bits.meaning: detailed fault code; valid when FAULT=1

bits.name: LAST_SESSION
bits.meaning: raw session_id of last completed/faulted frame; 255 if none or global reset

invariants: BUSY and READY are never both 1
DONE and READY are never both 1
FAULT and READY are never both 1
RESET_BUSY and READY are never both 1
FAULT is sticky until SOFT_RESET completes
ERR=0 on successful DONE; ERR!=0 on FAULT
no status bit has read-clear side effects

control_register.access: 32-bit pwrite; reserved bits must be written 0; one action bit per write

bits.name: SOFT_RESET
bits.meaning: self-clearing application reset: quiesce/abort current operation, reset H2C/C2H FIFO, parser, attention/KV FSM and DMA application state; do not reset PCIe HIP/BAR/link; clears FAULT; does not replace the in-band RESET_CACHE

bits.name: ABORT_BATCH
bits.meaning: optional first-version helper: stop current batch and enter FAULT; host then uses SOFT_RESET; no per-session abort

bits.name: ACK_DONE
bits.meaning: self-clearing; clear DONE after C2H has been consumed and validated; allowed only when DONE=1

host_rules: SOFT_RESET may be written after FAULT or when READY is unexpectedly stuck low; host must bound the wait
in-band RESET_CACHE is still required after SOFT_RESET before any ATTENTION/TEST

transitions.trigger: endpoint initialization; no in-flight, no fault
all histories logically cleared and 32B RESET ACK is stable
host CONTROL.SOFT_RESET or optional ABORT_BATCH then SOFT_RESET
SOFT_RESET application reset complete; FAULT=0; histories invalid

notes: RESET_BUSY from control SOFT_RESET has no C2H ACK; host must send RESET_CACHE afterwards
RESET_BUSY from in-band RESET_CACHE produces a 32B C2H ACK; host must read and validate it before ATTENTION/TEST
no per-session RESET/READY/FAULT state is defined in v3

reset_sequence: host reads STATUS twice; require stable snapshot
if FAULT=1 or READY=0: write CONTROL.SOFT_RESET=1; poll until READY=1 and FAULT=0 within reset_timeout; else root PERST recovery
host writes in-band RESET_CACHE (session_id=255, layer=255, position=0, seq, empty payload) only when READY=1, BUSY=0, DONE=0, FAULT=0
FPGA raises RESET_BUSY, blocks new dispatch, quiesces FIFO/engine/AXI, clears all (session,layer) history, M-store next_pos, cache valid and response state
FPGA makes the 32B RESET ACK stable, clears RESET_BUSY, sets READY=1; no physical DDR zero-fill is required but old KV must be logically unreadable
host reads exactly 32 bytes, validates header, session=255, op=RESET_CACHE, seq, CRC
only then host starts the first ATTENTION/TEST at position=0; create a new batch identity after any reset
frame_sequence: host reads STATUS; require READY=1, FAULT=0, BUSY=0, DONE=0, RESET_BUSY=0
host writes one complete H2C frame; write error is a local FAULT
host polls STATUS for DONE=1 or FAULT=1 within done_timeout
if FAULT=1: do not read C2H as success; recover
if DONE=1: require ERR=0; read exactly 1184 bytes for ATTENTION/TEST; validate echo, CRC and payload semantics
host writes CONTROL.ACK_DONE=1; poll READY=1 before the next frame
on any mismatch: local FAULT; drain C2H; SOFT_RESET; in-band RESET_CACHE; no automatic resend
fault_recovery: stop dispatch immediately; never append/retry a partially completed request
record STATUS, ERR, FAULT_CODE, LAST_SESSION, seq/layer/position/session and C2H drain bytes
drain/isolate old C2H until timeout; do not treat old frames as results
write CONTROL.SOFT_RESET; poll READY=1 and FAULT=0 within reset_timeout
if SOFT_RESET does not restore READY, stop and use root pcie1-recover.sh (PERST# + unbind/rebind); never pretend recovery succeeded
after recovery, send RESET_CACHE and re-create the whole batch; old batch/golden is invalid

timeouts.notes: Host defaults for fail-stop only; not hardware facts. Blocking H2C still has no hard application deadline; READY must be checked before every write.

transport.data_path: existing official SGDMA H2C/C2H character devices
transport.control_path: existing validated user/control character device 32-bit pread/pwrite

counters.binding: B must confirm offsets; PC2 candidate block is not valid until accepted
counters.snapshot_rule: write SNAPSHOT; read LO then HI; a 64-bit counter is valid only if SNAPSHOT was taken with no in-flight frame; no read-clear
